_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Data Description profile UML. Aligned to metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifDataDescription/schema.yaml. Standalone module (composes: []); the composite profile (DiscoveryDataDescription / DiscoveryDataDescriptionStructure) chains Core + Discovery in. Restored content the single-profile resolvedSchema inlines: fattened InstanceVariable with cdi:function / platformType / source / simpleUnitOfMeasure / hasIntendedDataType / describedUnitOfMeasure / uses / qualifies; value-domain description (ValueAndConceptDescription, EnumerationDomain) with all range / pattern / classification / default / format attributes; statistics extension (Statistic / Statistics / CategoryStatistics / StatisticsCollection / Category with typeOfStatistic / scale / weighted / computationBase / appliesTo / hasWeight / indexedBy); PrimaryKey -> ComponentPosition -> InstanceVariable; DefinedTerm + CdifConceptOrTerm (concept-or-term union shorthand); and the full set of CSV / fixed-width / numeric format attributes on TabularTextDataSet, TextMapping, PhysicalMapping, plus DataFingerprint algorithm details.

transformation.description: DDI-CDI to CDIF Data Description Profile

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Data Description Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Variable-level physical types, primary keys, statistics (with categories), value-domain description, physical mappings on distributions
targetModel.definition: CDIF Data Description profile module - adds: (a) cdif:hasPrimaryKey on the Dataset, (b) cdif:statistics on the Dataset, (c) richer InstanceVariable shape (cdif:physicalDataType required, value domains, units, function, source, concept-or-term references via cdif:uses), and (d) physical mapping on distribution items (PhysicalMapping / TextMapping / LocatorMapping), DataFingerprint, and cdi:characterSet on DataDownload + WebAPI's potentialAction.result.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Data Description profile additions: variable-level physical types, primary keys, statistics, value-domain description, distribution-level physical mappings.

package.name: Variables
package.definition: cdi:InstanceVariable with its physical data type, function, source, units, and concept-or-term references.

package.name: ValueDomains
package.definition: SubstantiveValueDomain / SentinelValueDomain (attach to InstanceVariable at DataDescription level), EnumerationDomain (codelist-backed enumerations), ValueAndConceptDescription (range / pattern / classification description).

package.name: Concepts
package.definition: schema:DefinedTerm reference target + the CdifConceptOrTerm union shorthand used as the value type of cdif:uses, hasIntendedDataType, describedUnitOfMeasure, etc.

package.name: Distribution
package.definition: Physical mapping family (AbstractMapping with PhysicalMapping / TextMapping / LocatorMapping subtypes), physical dataset family (AbstractDataSet with TabularTextDataSet / StructuredDataSet subtypes), and the DataFingerprint datatype.

package.name: Statistics
package.definition: cdif:statistics extension: Statistics bundles, CategoryStatistics (per-category breakdown), StatisticsCollection (named collection), Category (a category value).

package.name: Anchors
package.definition: Stub re-declarations of CDIFCore classes the profile attaches to (Dataset / CatalogRecord / DataDownload / WebAPI / ActionResult).

class._comment: Dataset stub.
class.definition: Stub of schema:Dataset (full definition in CDIFCore).

class._comment: CatalogRecord stub - typed schema:Dataset with schema:additionalType 'dcat:CatalogRecord' (Jun-2026 schema:subjectOf shape fix); carries the required https://w3id.org/cdif/data_description/1.1 conformance declaration and schema:about back-pointer to the described Dataset.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::CatalogRecord. For data-description, dcterms:conformsTo MUST include https://w3id.org/cdif/data_description/1.1.

attribute.name: additionalType
attribute.definition: schema:additionalType - MUST include 'dcat:CatalogRecord' (@type array itself is schema:Dataset).

attribute.name: about
attribute.definition: schema:about - @id back-pointer to the described Dataset.

class._comment: DataDownload stub.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::DataDownload. Carries cdif:hasPhysicalMapping, cdi:characterSet, cdi:fingerprint, optional co-typing as cdi:TabularTextDataSet or cdi:StructuredDataSet.

attribute.name: characterSet
attribute.definition: cdi:characterSet - character set used in the distribution.

class._comment: WebAPI stub.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::WebAPI. Carries potentialAction whose result has cdif:hasPhysicalMapping + cdi:characterSet at this profile level.

class._comment: ActionResult stub - schema.org Action's schema:result, the response object.
class.definition: Stub of CDIFCore::ActionResult. For data description, carries cdif:hasPhysicalMapping (to AbstractMapping) and cdi:characterSet.

attribute.name: characterSet
attribute.definition: cdi:characterSet - character set used in the API response.

class._comment: InstanceVariable - fattened with all the DataDescription-level attributes the resolvedSchema requires.
class.definition: A cdi:InstanceVariable as referenced by schema:variableMeasured. Carries the variable's identification, physical data type, value domains, units, function, source, and concept-or-term references.

attribute.name: physicalDataType
attribute.definition: cdif:physicalDataType - physical representation type. Required at Data Description level.

attribute.name: unitCode
attribute.definition: schema:unitCode - URL/code identifying the unit of measure.

attribute.name: unitText
attribute.definition: schema:unitText - text label for the unit of measure.

attribute.name: platformType
attribute.definition: cdi:platformType - the platform/system the variable was realized on.

attribute.name: measurementTechnique
attribute.definition: schema:measurementTechnique - measurement technique used for this variable.

class._comment: SubstantiveValueDomain - valid meaningful values of a variable.
class.definition: The substantive value domain for a variable (cdi:takesSubstantiveValuesFrom). May take values from an EnumerationDomain and be described by a ValueAndConceptDescription.

class._comment: SentinelValueDomain - missing / not-applicable codes.
class.definition: Sentinel (missing / NA) value domain for a variable (cdi:takesSentinelValuesFrom).

class._comment: EnumerationDomain - codelist-backed enumeration extension point for a value domain.
class.definition: Extension point letting a value domain reference a controlled-vocabulary codelist (cdif:takesValuesFrom -> CDIF codelist / skos:ConceptScheme).

class._comment: ValueAndConceptDescription - description of the values/concepts a value domain admits: ranges, patterns, classification level, format pattern, recommended datatype, semantic note, external definition.
class.definition: Description of the values / concepts a value domain admits: ranges (min/max value inclusive/exclusive), patterns (regularExpression, formatPattern, logicalExpression), classification level, recommended data type, default / required / external-definition info, plus general label / description / purpose annotations.

attribute.name: logicalExpression
attribute.definition: cdi:logicalExpression - logical expression constraining the domain.

attribute.name: classificationLevel
attribute.definition: cdi:classificationLevel - measurement level (nominal / ordinal / interval / ratio).

attribute.name: isRequired
attribute.definition: cdi:isRequired - whether a value is required.

attribute.name: defaultValue
attribute.definition: cdi:defaultValue - default value if not provided.

attribute.name: externalDefinition
attribute.definition: cdi:externalDefinition - URI of an external definition.

attribute.name: recommendedDataType
attribute.definition: cdif:recommendedDataType - recommended xsd-style data type for serialized values.

class._comment: schema:DefinedTerm - controlled-vocabulary term reference.
class.definition: schema:DefinedTerm - a term from a controlled vocabulary (DefinedTermSet). Used as a typed concept reference (e.g. cdi:hasIntendedDataType -> xsd-datatype DefinedTerm), and as one branch of CdifConceptOrTerm.

attribute.name: termCode
attribute.definition: schema:termCode - the code identifying the term within its DefinedTermSet.

class._comment: CdifConceptOrTerm - union shorthand: skos:Concept | schema:DefinedTerm. In JSON instances the value MAY be a plain string interpreted as the @id / prefLabel / termCode of the underlying ref. Used as the value type of cdif:uses (and similar concept-or-term properties).
class.definition: Union shorthand for 'a concept reference (skos:Concept) OR a defined term (schema:DefinedTerm)'. In JSON instances the value MAY be: (a) an inline object, (b) an @id-only object, or (c) a plain string interpreted as the @id / prefLabel / termCode of the underlying reference.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI of the concept or term.

class._comment: CdifConceptOrTermOrString - union shorthand wrapping CdifConceptOrTerm with a plain-string alternative. Matches the shared cdifConceptOrTermOrString building block; used wherever a property accepts either a controlled-vocabulary value or a plain string label.
class.definition: Union shorthand for 'a plain string OR the CdifConceptOrTerm 3-way union (skos:Concept @id-ref | schema:DefinedTerm | inline cdif:Concept)'.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI when the concept-or-term branch is used; absent when the value is a plain string.

class._comment: AbstractMapping - abstract supertype for cdif:hasPhysicalMapping items.
class.definition: Abstract supertype for the cdif:hasPhysicalMapping family. Concrete subtypes: PhysicalMapping (generic), TextMapping (delimited / fixed-width text), LocatorMapping (locator string for structured data). Every concrete mapping carries a cdif:formats_InstanceVariable reference.

class._comment: PhysicalMapping - generic per-field physical mapping with numeric-format attributes.
class.definition: Generic per-field physical mapping. Carries column index, format, physical data type, plus numeric-format details (decimal positions, separators, scale, length).

attribute.name: index
attribute.definition: cdif:index - column index of this variable's values.

attribute.name: format
attribute.definition: cdif:format - format token / pattern for parsing values.

attribute.name: physicalDataType
attribute.definition: cdif:physicalDataType - physical representation type for the column's bytes.

attribute.name: typeOfNumericValue
attribute.definition: cdi:typeOfNumericValue - type of numeric value (integer / decimal / ...).

attribute.name: arrayBase
attribute.definition: cdi:arrayBase - base index for array-valued columns (0 or 1).

class._comment: TextMapping - per-field mapping specialized for delimited / fixed-width text data.
class.definition: Per-field mapping specialized for delimited or fixed-width text data sets.

attribute.name: index
attribute.definition: cdif:index - column index of this variable.

attribute.name: isFixedWidth
attribute.definition: cdi:isFixedWidth - whether this is a fixed-width text column.

attribute.name: length
attribute.definition: cdi:length - column width for fixed-width data.

class._comment: LocatorMapping - per-field mapping for structured (hierarchical) data via a locator expression (XPath / JSONPath).
class.definition: Per-field mapping for structured / hierarchical data sets. Uses a locator expression rather than a column index.

class._comment: AbstractDataSet - abstract supertype for the cdi:PhysicalDataSet co-types.
class.definition: Abstract supertype for the cdi:PhysicalDataSet co-types a DataDownload may declare: TabularTextDataSet or StructuredDataSet.

class._comment: TabularTextDataSet - DataDownload co-typed as cdi:TabularTextDataSet. Carries the full set of delimited / fixed-width layout attributes.
class.definition: DataDownload co-typed as cdi:TabularTextDataSet: delimited or fixed-width text data set (CSV / TSV / fixed-width). Carries CSV-style layout attributes; per-field mappings are TextMapping.

attribute.name: isDelimited
attribute.definition: cdi:isDelimited - whether the file is delimited.

attribute.name: isFixedWidth
attribute.definition: cdi:isFixedWidth - whether the file is fixed-width.

attribute.name: hasHeader
attribute.definition: cdi:hasHeader - whether the file has a header row.

attribute.name: headerIsCaseSensitive
attribute.definition: cdi:headerIsCaseSensitive - whether header matching is case-sensitive.

attribute.name: quoteCharacter
attribute.definition: cdi:quoteCharacter - quote character for quoted values.

attribute.name: escapeCharacter
attribute.definition: cdi:escapeCharacter - escape character within quoted values.

attribute.name: commentPrefix
attribute.definition: cdi:commentPrefix - prefix marking a comment line.

attribute.name: skipBlankRows
attribute.definition: cdi:skipBlankRows - whether to skip blank rows.

attribute.name: skipDataColumns
attribute.definition: cdi:skipDataColumns - number of data columns to skip.

attribute.name: skipInitialSpace
attribute.definition: cdi:skipInitialSpace - whether to skip initial whitespace.

attribute.name: skipRows
attribute.definition: cdi:skipRows - number of leading rows to skip.

class._comment: StructuredDataSet - DataDownload co-typed as cdi:StructuredDataSet for hierarchical serializations.
class.definition: DataDownload co-typed as cdi:StructuredDataSet: hierarchical / structured data set (XML, JSON, ...). Per-field mappings are LocatorMapping.

class._comment: DataFingerprint - integrity fingerprint datatype.
class.definition: Integrity fingerprint (checksum / hash) of a distribution's bytes. Carried inline on a DataDownload via cdi:fingerprint.

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: Hash digest value as a hex string.

attribute.name: algorithmSpecification
attribute.definition: cdi:algorithmSpecification - specification document / URI of the algorithm.

attribute.name: typeOfFingerprint
attribute.definition: cdi:typeOfFingerprint - kind of fingerprint (e.g. checksum, hash, signature).

class._comment: PrimaryKey - cdif:hasPrimaryKey: cdif:isComposedOf an ordered list of ComponentPosition, each indexing an InstanceVariable.
class.definition: Primary key of the dataset: a cdif:Key whose cdif:isComposedOf is an ordered list of ComponentPosition entries, each indexing the InstanceVariable at that position in the key.

class._comment: ComponentPosition - position-in-key wrapper: pairs a position integer with the InstanceVariable at that position (cdi:indexes).
class.definition: Component-position wrapper used inside cdif:isComposedOf on a PrimaryKey. Carries cdif:position (1-based integer) and cdi:indexes (the InstanceVariable at that position).

attribute.name: position
attribute.definition: cdif:position - 1-based position of the component in the key.

class._comment: Statistics - bundle of one or more Statistic value objects for an InstanceVariable. Target of cdif:statistics on the Dataset.
class.definition: A named bundle of statistic value objects for an instance variable: typeOfStatistic, scale, content / numeric value, etc. Optionally weighted (by an InstanceVariable) and applies to one or more InstanceVariables.

attribute.name: typeOfStatistic
attribute.definition: cdi:typeOfStatistic - kind of statistic (mean, median, count, ...).

attribute.name: isWeighted
attribute.definition: cdi:isWeighted - whether the statistic is weighted.

attribute.name: computationBase
attribute.definition: cdi:computationBase - basis of computation (e.g. population, sample).

class._comment: CategoryStatistics - per-category statistics breakdown. Carries Statistics items and a Category they describe.
class.definition: Statistics broken down by Category. cdif:isComposedOf is a list of per-category Statistics; cdif:for points at the Category each is for.

class._comment: StatisticsCollection - named collection of Statistics / CategoryStatistics, optionally indexed by one or more InstanceVariables.
class.definition: Named collection of Statistics / CategoryStatistics. cdif:isComposedOf lists the contents; cdif:indexedBy lists the InstanceVariables the collection is indexed by.

class._comment: Category - a category value used in per-category statistics breakdowns (cdif:for on CategoryStatistics).
class.definition: A category value (cdi:Category) used to label per-category statistics breakdowns. Identified by @id and an optional value/label.

association.definition: schema:subjectOf - the catalog record describing this dataset's metadata.
schema:variableMeasured - the variables described.
cdif:hasPrimaryKey - primary key of the dataset.
cdif:statistics - summary statistics for the dataset.
schema:distribution - downloadable distribution.
schema:distribution - WebAPI distribution.
cdif:hasPhysicalMapping - per-field physical mappings.

association._comment: DataDownload -> AbstractDataSet via the cdi: physical-dataset co-typing.
association.definition: Co-typing: a DataDownload MAY also be cdi:TabularTextDataSet or cdi:StructuredDataSet.
cdi:fingerprint - integrity fingerprint.
schema:potentialAction.schema:result - the response object.
cdif:hasPhysicalMapping - per-field physical mappings for the API response.
cdif:formats_InstanceVariable - the InstanceVariable this mapping describes.
cdi:takesSubstantiveValuesFrom - substantive value domain.
cdi:takesSentinelValuesFrom - sentinel value domain.
cdif:uses - concept-or-term reference(s) for what this InstanceVariable measures or represents (string-shorthand permitted in JSON).
cdi:hasIntendedDataType - intended data type (typically an xsd-datatype DefinedTerm).
cdi:describedUnitOfMeasure - structured unit-of-measure reference.
cdi:function - the variable's function (geographic / weight / temporal designation, ...).
cdi:qualifies - the other InstanceVariable that this one qualifies.
cdif:isDescribedBy_StatisticsCollection - the statistics collection describing this variable.
cdi:source - provenance reference for the variable definition.
schema:measurementTechnique - typed measurement technique reference (string shorthand also permitted).
cdif:takesValuesFrom - controlled-vocabulary codelist for the substantive values.
cdif:takesValuesFrom - controlled-vocabulary codelist for the sentinel values.
cdi:isDescribedBy - description (ranges, patterns, classification level, ...) of the substantive values.
cdi:isDescribedBy - description of the sentinel values.

association._comment: EnumerationDomain -> CdifConceptOrTerm via cdif:references (the controlled-vocabulary entries).
association.definition: cdif:references - controlled-vocabulary entries (concept / term) the enumeration admits.
cdif:isComposedOf - ordered list of ComponentPosition entries, each indexing the InstanceVariable at that position.
cdi:indexes - the InstanceVariable at this position in the key.
cdif:appliesTo - the InstanceVariable(s) this Statistics bundle describes.
cdif:hasWeight - the InstanceVariable whose values were used as weights.
cdif:has_CategoryStatistics - per-category statistics within this bundle.
cdif:has_Statistics - nested statistic bundles.
cdif:isComposedOf - the per-category Statistics bundles.
cdif:for - the Category that this set of statistics is for.
cdif:isComposedOf - the Statistics bundles in the collection.
cdif:indexedBy - the InstanceVariable(s) the collection is indexed by.
